seo.title: Mr Wallet — Personal Budget & Expense Tracker
seo.description: Track accounts, budgets, expenses, debts, goals and recurring payments in one simple app. Multi-currency support (FCFA, EUR, USD). Free to start.

hero.title: Mr Wallet
hero.tagline: Pilot your cash, budgets and projects.
hero.description: Mr Wallet brings your accounts, expenses, debts, goals and recurrences into one simple, actionable experience.

features.title: All your financial steering, in one place
features.subtitle: A modular architecture where each business domain is isolated, with its own entities, rules and API.

items.title: Multiple accounts
items.description: Centralize all your accounts in a single view, with consolidated balances and history.

items.title: Transactions & categories
items.description: Classify every operation, track your spending by category and spot your trends.

items.title: Recurring transactions
items.description: Automate repetitive operations: rent, salary, subscriptions.

items.title: Budgets with alerts
items.description: Set caps per category and get alerted before you exceed them.

items.title: Debts & repayment schedule
items.description: Plan your debt repayments with a clear, forward-looking schedule.

items.title: Savings goals
items.description: Set targets, track your progress and stay motivated until the finish line.

items.title: CSV/Excel import & export
items.description: Import your statements with automatic deduplication, export your data any time.

items.title: Cash flow forecasts
items.description: Project your future financial situation from your income and expenses.

items.title: Net worth dashboard
items.description: A synthetic view of your net worth, real-time and easy to read.

principles.title: Designed for trust
principles.subtitle: Architectural choices that guarantee accuracy, independence and transparency.

items.title: Modularity
items.description: Each business domain is an isolated module with its own entities, rules and API.

items.title: No third-party connectors in V1
items.description: Data comes in via CSV/Excel import or manual entry. No external dependency.

items.title: Full traceability
items.description: Every action is timestamped and logged in an immutable audit trail.

items.title: Offline browsing
items.description: A read-only cache. Writing always requires the network.

items.title: One front, web and mobile
items.description: Installable, responsive-first PWA, rather than a native app.

items.title: Bilingual end to end
items.description: French and English from the MVP. No human text stored in the database, only stable identifiers.

items.title: Decoupled currencies
items.description: Multi-currency conversion with manually entered rates. No paid subscription required.

items.title: Monetary accuracy
items.description: No amount is ever stored or computed as a floating-point number.

security.title: Your data stays yours
security.description: No data is ever sent to a third party. Every action — create, update, delete — is timestamped and kept in an immutable audit trail. You export whenever you want, you leave whenever you want.

items.title: No external dependency
items.description: Your statements come in via import. Nothing goes out.

items.title: Import with deduplication
items.description: Your CSV/Excel statements are cleaned up automatically.

items.title: Export any time
items.description: Get your data back in CSV/Excel, no lock-in.

screenshots.title: See it in action
screenshots.subtitle: A quick look at the dashboard, budgets and transactions on your phone.

testimonials.title: Loved by early users
testimonials.subtitle: A few words from people managing their money with Mr Wallet.

items.name: Awa D.
items.quote: First budget app that actually understands mobile money fees and irregular income.

items.name: Kossi M.
items.quote: I finally know exactly how much I can spend today without checking three apps.

items.name: Fatou S.
items.quote: Setting up my first savings goal took two minutes. Seeing the progress bar move keeps me motivated.

controlCta.title: Take back control of your finances
controlCta.description: Start for free. Import your statements, set up your budgets and project your financial future today.

designedFor.title: Designed for West Africa
designedFor.description: The app starts from the ground: cash, mobile money, variable income, family support, informal debts and very concrete savings goals.
reasons: FCFA by default, with EUR and USD when your finances go abroad
Built for irregular income, mobile money fees and transfers between accounts
An internal ledger keeps balances consistent, even as history grows
Two languages from day one, French and English

items.question: Is my data protected?
items.answer: Encryption and a full audit log.

items.question: Can I import from my bank?
items.answer: CSV/Excel today, direct connectors are planned.

items.question: How do I get my data back?
What happens if I delete my account?
items.answer: Soft delete, then permanent deletion after 30 days.

accountDeletion.title: Request account deletion
accountDeletion.intro: You can permanently delete your Mr Wallet account and all associated data at any time.
accountDeletion.selfServiceNote: Your account and all associated data (accounts, transactions, budgets, categories, tags, debts, goals, recurrences, notifications, push devices) are permanently deleted immediately. This action cannot be undone.
accountDeletion.noAccessBody: Email us from the address linked to your account and we will delete it for you within 30 days.
